task: Is A/B testing for ML mentioned in the corpus? If so, list the main stages.
final_answer: Yes, A/B testing for ML is covered in the corpus. The four main stages are: (1) Hypothesis formulation — define the business metric to improve and the minimum detectable effect; (2) Traffic splitting — randomly assign users to control vs. treatment with stable per-user randomization; (3) Guardrail metrics — track secondary metrics that should not regress even if the primary metric improves; (4) Statistical analysis — compute confidence intervals and p-values, avoiding peeking to prevent inflated false positive rates.
